questions.prompt: Abi is x years old. Bob is twice as old as Abi. Cam is 3 years older than Bob. The total of their ages is 58. Form an equation and solve to find x.
A rectangle has the dimensions shown. Its perimeter is 46 cm. Form an equation and solve to find x.
The diagram shows a regular pentagon. Each side is 3x − 4 cm and the perimeter is 70 cm. Form an equation and solve to find x.
The two lines are parallel. Form an equation using the angles shown and solve to find x.
The angles in the triangle add to 180°. Form an equation and solve to find x.
The two angles form a straight line. Form an equation and solve to find x.
The diagram is a parallelogram. Adjacent angles are supplementary. Form an equation and solve to find x.
Three consecutive integers have a total of 72. Let the smallest integer be x. Form an equation and solve to find x.
A cinema charges a fixed booking fee of £4 plus £2.50 for each ticket. The total cost is £24. Form an equation and solve to find the number of tickets.
